focus_areas: Verification of bony scute texture realism
Anatomical correctness of the heterocercal tail
Integrity of the man's hands interacting with the fish (boundary separation)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the texture of the scutes. Real sturgeon scutes are sharp and irregular; AI often smooths them into uniform bumps. Also, scrutinize the connection between the man's hands and the fish body for any 'melting' or missing fingers using topology checks.
